description: NHFLOW hydrostatic semi-implicit step (A 510 12, theta 0.55, N 47 0.4) on a curvilinear grid (G 50 2): a 2 m flume of 200 x 4 cells (dx 0.01 m, 10 layers) rotated by 30 deg, h 0.109 m, U 0.42 m/s, log-law bed friction, a 3 mm step of the bed in the node levels, 200 steps (t = 1.8 s). The estimate pass of the advecting transport (tp2, A 505 1) on the grids without tl2: with the transport of the step before (one pass) the short waves behind the inflow grew to 30 mm within 1.3 s (theta 0.7 or 1 stable).
covers: nhflow_momentum_SI::step_single: the two passes with tp2 (curvilinear)
